summary.text: Nie Kuang Feng is the tornado immortal among Crazed Demon Cave's eighth-layer mutant Gu Immortals.

claims.text: Fairy Yu Xiu conducts Dao lessons that draw mutant Gu Immortals from small worlds and beyond. She chooses three leaders from those who join Green Lotus: rock monkey Bu Tian Kong, the tornado immortal Nie Kuang Feng, and lizard Gu Immortal Duan Hu from Savage Wilderness Great World.

Nie Kuang Feng breaks out of the Rotting Smell Vicious Cloud ancient battle formation formed by six eggman Gu Immortals from Rotten Egg grotto-heaven, leaving them dead or injured. Fang Yuan calls Nie Kuang Feng, Bu Tian Kong, and Duan Hu the luck children of Crazed Demon Cave’s eighth layer, born with immense innate luck.

Nie Kuang Feng is a green tornado that condenses into a ball and bursts with suction force. Against Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch it uses its signature killer move Wind Suction Life Twister, which it spent thirty years creating and a hundred years modifying, claiming nobody has survived it. Black lightning and other tribulations in Yellow Earth Great World target it repeatedly and interrupt the kill. Fairy Yu Xiu later says Nie Kuang Feng represents the small worlds among those with the greatest innate luck in the eighth layer, which is why Fang Yuan’s amplified tribulations prioritize it with Bu Tian Kong.

On the chaotic eighth-layer battlefield, Bu Tian Kong, Nie Kuang Feng, and Duan Hu are the strongest Gu Immortals shining there. Heavenly Court has many mutant Gu Immortals joining it, including those three. Xiao He Jian, Green Forest Great Sage, and Black Locust bind Nie Kuang Feng with wood path vines that interrupt its immortal essence. From inside the vine ball it warns that every desperate predicament forces demonization, and that once it demonizes it loses consciousness until it destroys everyone and everything in that world.

After demonization it becomes a reddish brown demonic wind, kills Green Forest Great Sage and Black Locust, and drives Xiao He Jian toward defeat. When Fang Yuan casually kills Bu Tian Kong nearby, Nie Kuang Feng freezes, drops demonization in terror, and flees the battlefield, leaving the dying Xiao He Jian behind.

Nie Kuang Feng and Duan Hu lead troops defending for Heavenly Court. Xiao He Jian and Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch face it together after recovering from earlier losses. Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch seals it in Extreme Ice Crystal Light Immortal Suppression Coffin. Under death pressure it demonizes again and cracks the coffin from within. Xiao He Jian finishes the kill with Cut Grass, leaf blades piercing through ice cracks. It offers to surrender; Xiao He Jian refuses under master’s orders. Nie Kuang Feng dies to Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch and Xiao He Jian, and the mutant Gu Immortals lose that leader.
Later recounting of Crazed Demon Cave losses names Nie Kuang Feng among countless lifeforms that died there, together with Bu Tian Kong and Duan Hu.
